# Take Photo

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Takes a photo.

## Syntax

~~~~text
takePhoto(camera: <#Enumeration (WFCameraCaptureDevice) (Optional)#>, preview: <#Boolean (Optional)#>, count: <#Number (Allows Variables) (Optional)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
takePhoto(camera: Back, preview: false, count: 5)
~~~~
